profile_text: As a leading provider of event catering and restaurant services in Düsseldorf, Germany, this company has experienced rapid growth, with a 133.3% increase in employees since its baseline. Its specialized services cater to a wide range of events, driving demand and expansion. With 35 employees as of 2024, the company's success can be attributed to its ability to deliver high-quality culinary experiences, solidifying its position in the accommodation and food service sector.
